text:
ryan-support: GreenArc (enterprise) reporting widespread 502/504 + client timeouts since 16:02 UTC in hosted-us-west. Support ticket #8142. Customer can repro with bursts of short chat requests, error spike coincides with deploy window. Anyone triaging?

ops-bot: [ALERT] hosted-gateway.queue_depth high -> 1024 at 16:03 UTC; continuous-batcher.backlog=76k; gateway.tail_p95=8.1s; 5xx-rate up x12. Dashboard: https://internal.grafana/redwood/hosted-gateway (prod/us-west) :rotating_light:

alex: @ryan-support can you paste a failing request id + sample curl? Which model and route?

ryan-support: req id: req_0x9a7f; route: /v1/generate; model: redwood/ggml-13b-q4_0 (hosted). Repro curl I sent to the customer:
```
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-ggml-13b","input":"short chat loop","max_tokens":64}'
```
They run this in a tight loop (50 qps burst per connection) and see timeouts/502s after ~30s.

priya: quick triage notes: continuous-batcher workers are accumulating backlog because longseq KV-cache spinups are blocking batch formation. Per-worker queue depth hit the configured limit (1024) and gateway started early-rejecting/returning 502s for queued tail requests. Snippet from worker logs around 16:03:
```
[16:03:11] worker=wb-12 queue_depth=1024 head_latency_ms=120 tail_wait_ms=8200 backlog_items=76321
[16:03:12] evicting incoming request req_0x9a7f reason=queue_depth_limit
[16:03:12] emit: gateway_response code=502 reason=queue-saturated
```
Also saw repeated KV cache load stalls on cold shards (kvcache_load_ms ~ 6000).

priya: repro from our side (dev sandbox): ran a 100-concurrency burst against the same model, saw continuous-batcher backlog jump and per-worker queue_clamp engage. Repro script used: `wrk -c100 -t8 -d30s --script=short-chat.lua` (attached in thread).

alex: immediate mitigation options: 1) raise ingress.queue_max_depth for hosted-us-west prod from 1024 -> 2048 (short term), 2) enable shed-mode for noisy tenants (throttle/early-reject), 3) roll out small batching-timeout tweak to avoid long KV cache stalls holding batches, 4) scale up worker pool. Which should we do now?

sam: I'm going to apply (1) and enable targeted shed (2) for tenants causing the burst (customer IDs in ticket). Patching now. Patching command: `kubectl set env deployment/gateway -n hosted-prod INGRESS_QUEUE_MAX_DEPTH=2048` then restarting gateway pods with graceful drain. Will do canary then full.

elaine: I'll coordinate the restart and watch health checks. Applying canary to 2 pods now.

ops-bot: [RUN] canary update started on gateway-hosted-us-west (pods 3/5). Health ok on first pod.

maria: I PM'd the GreenArc CS rep to say we're triaging; asked for their test timestamp and exact repro script. They're standing by. :eyes:

sam: canary success, rolling to remaining gateway pods. Also enabled tenant-level shed for the top 2 tenant ids from the ticket (rate-limited).

ops-bot: hosted-gateway.queue_depth dropped to 480 within 90s of full rollout; continuous-batcher.backlog down to 4k; 5xx-rate trending to baseline.

elaine: restart complete, verified no 5xx in last 2m for affected route. Confirmed metrics: p95 tail latency down from 8s -> 230ms.

ryan-support: Customer confirmed errors reduced, they report normal behavior now. Updating ticket #8142 and closing as "mitigated - followup required".

alex: follow-up items: - INC-12345 created for full RCA + postmortem (owner: eng-runtime) - add a targeted runbook step for quick tenant-side throttling and a dashboard alert for per-tenant queue pressure - investigate kvcache warmup + batching-timeout fix; schedule rolling deploy with small batch timeout change (priya + runtime)

priya: initial root cause hypothesis: short bursty small requests + cold kvcache loads -> long per-request KV load stalls -> continuous-batcher worker can't form or flush batches -> per-worker queue hits configured clamp -> gateway starts early reject/502 for queued tails. Longer term: better load shedding, kvcache pre-warming, and per-tenant smoothing.

maria: I'll notify customer success to prepare a short incident note for GreenArc and offer mitigation guidance (backoff/retry jitter).

ryan-support: Thanks all. Marking this thread resolved for now. Will post RCA draft in #postmortems when INC-12345 is ready. :white_check_mark:
